name: BSP_DialogChannelRecord_Copy
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = destination 0x14-byte streamed-dialog channel record, arg = source record), returns the destination. Called at 00a872ac to place a record into the vector at table +0x08. Zeroes the destination name string ({length, char*} at +0x00/+0x04), reads the source format index at +0x10, recomputes the channel count as DAT_00e12ef0[index] into +0x08, deep-copies the name through BSP_NativeString_Resize (0041dd40) plus memcpy, then overwrites +0x08 and +0x0c from the source. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_AUDIO_ONLINE.md; reports/app_init_audio_online.json.

name: BSP_DialogStreamTable_Load
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); called at 0073db2b immediately after the sound system. Reconstructed in packet app_init_audio_online. __thiscall(ECX = a 0x234-byte streamed-dialog manager from operator new at 0073db02), RET 0 and no stack arguments. Base ctor 00a778d0; vtable 00d58f78; eh_vector_constructor_iterator builds 0x12 records of 0x18 bytes at +0x10 (ctor 004c87d0, dtor 004c87f0) and 0x12 dwords at +0x1c0 (ctor 00a778c0, dtor 0052e020); +0x208 = -1; +0x210 = 0; byte +0x214 = 1; byte +0x215 = 0; +0x218..+0x224 = 1.0f (DAT_00d7a24c); +0x228 = +0x230 = 0. operator new(0x20) builds the reference-counted definition table (vtable written as 00ceb130 then 00d58f80, refcount 1, vector at +0x08/+0x0c/+0x10, volume 1.0f at +0x14, running channel total at +0x18, loop byte at +0x1c) and stores it at +0x22c after releasing any previous one through InterlockedDecrement. It then builds the native string 'sound/streamed_dialogs.def' (0x1a characters, 00d58f88) and passes it to BSP_DialogStreamTable_Parse (00a87060), which is a plain text tokenizer, not Lua. Finally +0x04 = operator new(0xc) holding a count of 1 plus one 8-byte element, +0x08 = operator new(0x5c) with ctor 00a78150(0) and +0x0c = operator new(0x5c) with ctor 00a781c0(0). Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_AUDIO_ONLINE.md; reports/app_init_audio_online.json; docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md.

name: BSP_SoundSystem_SampleFmodMemoryStats
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Supersedes BSP_SoundSystem_ReportFmodMemoryFailure: the body only samples FMOD memory statistics into two discarded locals (no failure branch, no report), and BSP_Game_EnterFrontEndShell (004e4000) calls it as one of three memory checkpoints (docs/GAME_FRONTEND_ENTRY.md). Earlier evidence: see git history of this record. | Call-site evidence from the audio packet (previous record, name BSP_SoundSystem_ReportFmodMemoryFailure): Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __stdcall(const char* message), RET 4. The single failure handler of BSP_SoundSystem_Initialize (00a88770): every FMOD call there is compared against 0x2b (FMOD_ERR_MEMORY) and, on a match, this is called with 00d5ab94 'Out of sounjd memory:' (misspelling is in the shipped image) and with ECX loaded from DAT_00f8bbd8. In this build the body ignores both the argument and ECX: it only calls FMOD_Memory_GetStats (00c2ddee) into two discarded stack locals and returns, so the message never reaches a log. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_AUDIO_ONLINE.md; reports/app_init_audio_online.json. | CORRECTION CANDIDATE from packet game_frontend_shell_entry (address not leased there; reported rather than renamed). The disk body is only: SUB ESP,8; LEA EAX,[ESP]; PUSH EAX; LEA ECX,[ESP+8]; PUSH ECX; CALL 00c2ddee; ADD ESP,8; RET 4. 00c2ddee is the FMOD_Memory_GetStats import thunk, so the routine samples FMOD's current and maximum allocation into two stack locals, discards both, and never reads its single stack argument. It is not a failure handler: 004e4000 calls it at 004e4051 with the label 'Sounds before mainmenu' (00CE82B0) as one of three memory checkpoints, alongside the renderer vtable +70h and 004c1650/0086b0b0 probes. A name such as BSP_SoundSystem_ProbeFmodMemory fits both call sites; the label argument is stripped instrumentation.
